claim: In the late thirteenth century a Pandyan intervention led by an Arya Cakravarti penetrated Yapahuwa and carried the Tooth Relic to the Pandyan realm, exposing the vulnerability even of a fortified capital and linking the island’s dynastic crisis directly to South Indian power politics.
bounded_by: The exact dating is usually placed around 1284 and source traditions differ on details surrounding Bhuvanekabahu I’s death/interregnum. Keep the documented Pandyan/Arya Cakravarti intervention distinct from later fully developed Jaffna state structures.
notes: Bridge candidate: Pandyan intervention → Aryacakravarti consolidation in the north/Jaffna.
